warning: No causal/readout conclusion. Controls are candidates only and only valid within observed FIT scope; count/norm tolerance does not guarantee TEST balance.

scope_correction.reason: Original frozen worker/protocol/report incorrectly described actual FIT as64blocks/so-only. Numeric worker used all128documents and32actualblocks. Correct metadata without rerunning matching or changing any selected group.
scope_correction.numerical_adoption: All original pooled numeric distributions, scores, thresholds, decoder algebra, heuristic groups and analytic bound adopted unchanged; tolerance resampling dynamically used32blocks. Per-frame diagnostics added posthoc for fixed groups only.

so.interpretation: Descriptive posthoc stratification of unchanged pooled-selected groups, not a separate per-frame selection/optimization or independent test.

when.interpretation: Descriptive posthoc stratification of unchanged pooled-selected groups, not a separate per-frame selection/optimization or independent test.
